finding.title: Repair the broken custom_lint toolchain so the nine custom lints enforce again

evidence.quote: custom_lint 0.8.1 vs analyzer 9.0.0 — `dart run custom_lint` exits 255 with compile errors in custom_lint_core (Element2 isn't a type)

finding.why: All nine custom lint rules (layering, Firebase confinement, raw Talker, RTL geometry, color literals, e.toString-in-UI, raw logEvent) currently enforce NOTHING: the tool crashes before analysis locally, and CI runs it warn-only. docs/coding-standards.md line 766 tells developers 'local make audit + dart run custom_lint are the real gate — run them', which is impossible for the lint half; only the audit greps remain as a hard gate, and they cover fewer rules.
finding.recommendation: Upgrade custom_lint/custom_lint_core to an analyzer-9-compatible release (or pin analyzer ^8 in the workspace) so `dart run custom_lint` runs clean; then correct the doc's claim or flip CI custom_lint to hard-fail. First mechanical step: `dart pub upgrade custom_lint --major-versions` in packages/custom_lints and learning_tracker, run the tool, fix API breakage in the 9 rules.
acceptance_criteria: `cd learning_tracker && dart run custom_lint` exits 0 and reports per-file diagnostics
CI custom_lint step hard-fails on violations (warn-only removed) or the standards doc states the real status
